C0092.title: Jiangsu Police Dismantle Forced Pop-up Operation for Illegal Computer System Control
C0092.summary: Suspects, under the guise of ad removal and antivirus, colluded with internet cafe maintenance staff to install a software called 'X Hunter' on cafe computers. The software modified and replaced browser process parameters, locked homepages, and increased pop-ups to illegally control the computers, directing traffic to fraud and gambling schemes.
